sql.attachment.findById: SELECT id, attachment_type_id, company_id, filename, content_type, s3_key, display_name, size, uuid, archived, substring(filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, date_created, date_modified, created_by_id, modified_by_id, show FROM flow.attachment WHERE id = :id and archived is not true
sql.attachment.getAttachmentForUuidCheck: SELECT a.id, a.content_type, a.display_name, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.uuid FROM flow.attachment a WHERE a.id = :id AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentById: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.uuid, a.s3_key, a.display_name, a.size, substring(a.filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, a.archived, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a WHERE a.id = :id AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentsByType: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.display_name, a.uuid, a.show, substring(a.filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.archived FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE order by a.date_created desc
sql.attachment.getAttachmentByUUID: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.display_name, a.size, a.uuid, a.show, substring(a.filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.archived FROM flow.attachment a WHERE a.uuid = :uuid
sql.attachment.getAttachmentsByTypeNoSource: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.display_name, a.uuid, a.show, substring(a.filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.archived FROM flow.attachment a WHERE a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE order by a.date_created desc
sql.attachment.getAttachmentBySourceAndType: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, substring(a.filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.uuid, a.display_name, a.archived, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE src.source_id = :sourceId AND a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE LIMIT 1
sql.attachment.getAttachmentsBySourceIdAndTy: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.uuid, a.s3_key, a.display_name, a.size, substring(a.filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, src.source_id, a.archived FROM flow.attachment a LEFT JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE case when :sourceId::int IS NOT NULL then src.source_id = :sourceId else 1 = 1 end AND a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentBySourceAndTypeF: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.uuid, a.display_name, a.archived, substring(a.filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE src.source_id = any( array [ :sourceIds ]::integer[] ) AND a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived is not true
sql.attachment.create: INSERT INTO flow.attachment(filename, content_type, s3_key, size, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, attachment_type_id, company_id, uuid, display_name) VALUES(:filename, :contentType, :key, :size, now(), :createdById, now(), :createdById, :attachmentTypeId, :companyId, uuid_generate_v4(), :displayName)
sql.attachment.deleteById: UPDATE flow.attachment SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE id = :id
sql.attachment.deleteBySourceAndType: UPDATE flow.attachment a SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById FROM ( SELECT src.attachment_id FROM flow.attachment_source src inner join flow.attachment a on a.id = src.attachment_id WHERE src.source_id = :sourceId AND a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId ) AS s WHERE a.id = s.attachment_id
sql.attachment.getAttachmentType: select at.id, at.attachment_type, at.is_system, at.key_pattern_id, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where at.id = :id
sql.attachment.update: update flow.attachment set display_name = :displayName, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
